records.summary: A companion app for checking Premium Bonds prize results on iOS, with Android also mentioned. The idea responds to a reported delay in official email alerts, but the source says winning numbers are published free.

competitors.name: NS&I Premium Bonds prize checker
competitors.note: Official; 2.6★/1,357 ratings on iOS and 3.6★ with 1m+ downloads on Google Play.

competitors.name: NS&I app
competitors.note: Official app; 1.6★/306 on iOS and 1.4★ with 500k+ downloads on Google Play.

competitors.name: Premium Bonds Prize Checker +
competitors.note: Android third-party app; 4.1★/92 reviews and 10k+ downloads.

competitors.name: Numo
competitors.note: Described as an iOS entrant with 0 ratings.

rounds.plain: Killed for no evidence of willingness to pay and trademark risk. The source also says free winning-number data and existing text and email alerts weaken the case.

records.moat: Low: free data and a trivial-to-clone app; Android already has an indie alternative.

records.summary: A smart-tariff companion for Octopus Energy, proposed as a successor to OctoTracker. Features would include widgets and alerts for the cheapest usage slots.

competitors.name: OctoTracker
competitors.note: Moved to the web; iOS 4.8★/1,173 ratings and Android 4.8★/443 reviews, 10k+ downloads.

competitors.name: Octopus Compare
competitors.note: Moved to the web.

competitors.name: OctoDash: Octopus Agile Rates
competitors.note: Android, 4.8★/49 reviews and 1k+ downloads; updated 25 Sep 2026.

competitors.name: Octopus Watch
competitors.note: 4.5★/940 reviews and 10k+ downloads; updated Jul 2026.

rounds.plain: Killed because the research found no evidence that apps in this space pay. Copying is already underway, and the idea depends on Octopus's public API and its own app not absorbing the features.

risks: Depends on Octopus API and its own app
records.moat: Weak: copying is underway, and the idea depends on a public API and a large incumbent app.

records.summary: The record's proposed idea is a UK consumer app for smart-meter and home-energy data, although the record is titled “FreeAgent connector layer.” The research says consumer smart-meter data requires a consent-based data provider, but the route and cost are unverified.

competitors.name: Equali
competitors.note: FreeAgent's official e-commerce partner; the help centre mentions 20% off.

competitors.name: Loop Energy
competitors.note: Google Play listing: 2.0★, 100k+ downloads; updated 13 Jul 2026.

competitors.name: ivie
competitors.note: Google Play listing: 3.9★/659, 50k+ downloads; updated Feb 2026.

competitors.name: Smart Meter Pro
competitors.note: Google Play listing: 4.9★/251, 5k+ downloads; updated Jul 2026.

rounds.plain: The validation says the official partner Equali owns distribution for the FreeAgent connector idea. The accompanying scout record instead describes a smart-meter app, so the source does not establish that this verdict applies to that idea.

risks: The record title and scout idea conflict
Smart-meter data access route and cost unverified
Integration may be brittle and reduce automation
records.moat: For the smart-meter idea, data access is described as both the potential moat and blocker; the route and cost are unverified. For the titled FreeAgent idea, the source says Equali is the official partner.

records.summary: A replacement Google Chat notifications app for Jira Cloud, intended to address problems with a stale incumbent. The source reports complaints about setup, security settings, project search, and notifications.
records.customer: Jira Cloud users who use Google Chat

competitors.name: Google Chat for Jira Cloud
competitors.note: 11,008 installs, 2.30★/109 reviews; latest version released 11 Nov 2021.

competitors.name: Advanced Google Chat for Jira
competitors.note: 406 installs, 5.0★/3; first version Mar 2024.

competitors.name: Google Chat for Jira
competitors.note: 123 installs, 4.06★/4.

competitors.name: Google Chat Automation Actions for Jira
competitors.note: 3 installs; released Nov 2025.

competitors.name: Chatpane
competitors.note: The validation says this newer app targets the same complaints; released 16 Oct 2026.

rounds.plain: Killed because Google offers a free app, a free Advanced alternative exists, and Chatpane has already targeted the same complaints. The research says the gap is real but not exclusive and the app is cheap to clone.

records.moat: Limited: switching from the stale incumbent may be slow, but the gap is not exclusive and Forge apps are cheap to clone.

records.summary: A Jira Cloud integration connecting Harvest time tracking with Jira. The proposed successor would address reported issues recording time against Jira tickets and syncing Jira time-tracking fields.
records.customer: Jira Cloud users who use Harvest

competitors.name: Harvest Time Tracking (Official)
competitors.note: 2,439 installs, 2.53★/145 reviews; last release 29 Jun 2021.

competitors.name: Harvest Time Tracking by 42nd
competitors.note: 375 installs, 4.26★/27 reviews.

competitors.name: Twinsun Harvest app
competitors.note: 27 installs; release in Sep-Oct 2026.

competitors.name: marcelbag Harvest app
competitors.note: 9 installs; release in Sep-Oct 2026.

competitors.name: Metronome Harvest app
competitors.note: 3 installs; release in Sep-Oct 2026.

rounds.plain: Killed because the research found multiple recent entrants and concluded the market fails the moat check. The three release dates are given as Sep-Oct 2026, but their launch dates were not confirmed.

risks: Recent complaints were more than 18 months old at assessment
records.moat: Fails the moat check: three new entrants had Sep-Oct 2026 releases, and the incumbent had a small base of about 2.4k installs.

records.summary: A general approach of replacing official Atlassian integrations after a vendor shuts down or stops updating them. The source identifies orphaned apps with at least 1,000 installs and notes that replacement apps appeared quickly for InVision.
records.customer: Atlassian Marketplace users of abandoned integrations

competitors.name: Miro for Jira
competitors.note: 12,250 installs, 3.89★; last release 8 Mar 2024.

competitors.name: Render Markdown
competitors.note: 3,853 installs, 3.46★; last release Oct 2021.

competitors.name: Azure Pipelines for Jira (Deprecated)
competitors.note: 2,589 installs, 2.11★/119; last release in 2019.

competitors.name: InVision & Freehand+ replacement apps
competitors.note: Two replacement apps released 22 Oct 2026 after InVision shut down.

competitors.name: Chatpane
competitors.note: Cited in the validation as a fast copy in the Google Chat for Jira category.

rounds.plain: Killed because copying is fast: InVision replacements appeared soon after shutdown, and Harvest also drew several entrants. The source says only orphans with no named successor and more than 5k installs are worth considering; it identifies Google Chat as the only current case.

risks: Fast competition after an orphan event
Few qualifying opportunities in the source
records.moat: Weak: replacements appeared quickly for InVision, and the research says copying is fast on Atlassian Marketplace.

records.summary: A Confluence Cloud app for creating or viewing Mermaid diagrams, intended as a better alternative to existing apps. The source does not specify which features would be improved.
records.customer: Confluence Cloud users who need Mermaid diagrams

competitors.name: Mermaid diagrams viewer
competitors.note: Atlassian app with 7,685 installs, 2.99★/26 reviews.

competitors.name: Mermaid Chart for Confluence
competitors.note: 4,089 installs, 2.84★/20 reviews.

competitors.name: Other Mermaid-matching apps
competitors.note: 84 apps matched “mermaid”; several were rated 4.0-4.6★ and updated Sep-Oct 2026. Validation says 107 matching apps.

rounds.plain: Killed because the category is crowded: the scout counted 84 apps matching “mermaid,” while validation reported 107 matching apps. The source describes many active alternatives and says the idea fails the moat check.

records.moat: Fails the moat check: the source reports 84 matching apps in the scout and 107 in validation, with many actively updated.

records.summary: A proposed third-party fix for problems with Stripe and PayPal payment feeds into Xero. The research says many reported problems concern provider fees and account setup rather than features a third party could fix.
records.customer: Xero users connecting Stripe or PayPal

competitors.name: Stripe
competitors.note: Xero app, 2.47★/383; complaints cited include fees and Xero account creation.

competitors.name: PayPal
competitors.note: PayPal app, 3.47★/136.

competitors.name: A2X
competitors.note: 4.96★/945; cited as an established connector.

rounds.plain: Killed because the complaints target Xero or the payment providers, so a third party cannot address them. Established connectors already serve Stripe-to-Xero reconciliation.

risks: Problems cited are outside a third party's control
records.moat: Not established; the main complaints concern fees, holds, or account setup, and the source says established connectors already serve reconciliation.

records.summary: A tool to export or archive Xero data for businesses leaving Xero or needing backups. The research found a thin supply signal but did not measure demand.
records.customer: Businesses leaving Xero or needing data backups

competitors.name: Xportmydata
competitors.note: Listed Oct 2020; 2.82★/11 reviews; newest review Feb 2024.

rounds.plain: Killed because alternatives already serve the need. The scout says demand is unmeasured and competition outside its partial store sample is unknown.

risks: Competition outside the partial sample unknown
records.moat: Unknown; the scout says demand is unproven and competition outside the sample is unknown.
